name: Windows Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Windows Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for windows solutions.

overview: Windows Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners replacing drafty, failing or outdated windows and connect them with window companies for in-home consultations.

Homeowners considering a window project usually want to understand pricing ranges, materials and timelines before committing to a consultation, and a phone call is the fastest way to get those answers. Inbound Call programs place window replacement offers in front of homeowners researching the category and invite them to call the company directly. Callers arrive with a project in mind and often know roughly how many windows they need, allowing appointment setters to qualify the opportunity, address objections and schedule an in-home consultation within a single conversation.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of windows consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Owners of single-family homes built more than fifteen to twenty years ago with original or failing windows, typically aged 40 to 70 with equity or financing capacity. The most valuable segments are homeowners replacing five or more windows, those motivated by energy efficiency and comfort, and owners of older homes seeking a full exterior update alongside doors or siding.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for window replacement cost or window companies near me; drafts, condensation between panes or fogged glass observed; windows difficult to open, close or lock, or showing rot around frames; heating and cooling bills rising noticeably.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "window replacement cost" and "window companies near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard windows criteria include: owns a single-family home within the company's service area; number of windows to be replaced meets the company's minimum; reason for replacement and any specific window types identified; project timeline stated, typically within the next several months; homeowner and co-decision maker available for an in-home consultation; openness to financing or a stated budget for the project.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can you enforce a minimum number of windows?
faq.a: Yes. Screening captures the number of windows the homeowner plans to replace, and a minimum threshold can be set to match your project requirements.

faq.q: Do you confirm that both homeowners can attend the consultation?
faq.a: Decision-maker availability is part of the standard screening, which supports in-home sales models that require all owners to be present.

faq.q: Can programs include doors or siding alongside windows?
faq.a: Campaigns can be expanded to cover entry doors, patio doors and siding if you offer them, and screening can identify homeowners interested in multiple exterior products.
